title: Explicit two-branch status
natural_language: Write offline to /work/status when /work/maintenance exists; otherwise write online. Do not append a newline.
formal_query: if file /work/maintenance exists then create file at /work/status with content="offline" otherwise create file at /work/status with content="online"
environment: Debian 13 disposable container; root; offline fixtures
provenance: Authored for this extension; not mined from independent workloads
idempotence: state checked after two successful executions; changed-count not scored
